title: write_todo tool is seeing MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL errors
body: This has resulted in a regression because we exit after a malformed function call error. This is because the json output by the model is incorrect. Update the output format such that we see a lower number of these errors.

linked_prs.title: Enable write_todo tool and fix output function schema
linked_prs.body:
## Summary
Enable write_todo tool and fix schema regression.

## Details
* Tool Enablement: The write_todos tool is now enabled by default. This was done by updating the default configuration in
     packages/core/src/config/config.ts and updating the corresponding settings schemas in
 packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts and schemas/settings.schema.json.
 * Schema Correction: The responseJsonSchema for the write_todos tool has been fixed in packages/core/src/tools/write-todos.ts. The schema now correctly defines the response as an object containing a todos array, where each item is an object with description and status properties.
* Documentation: The documentation has been updated to reflect that the write_todos tool is now enabled by default.

## Related Issues

Fixes #12675 

## How to Validate

Start gemini-cli and verify that you can use the ToDo tool successfully. Evals show no regression.
